name: Aura
reason: Health restore, re-checked under the new rule (12 Nov 2026), borderline: Aura's home page (www.aurahealth.io, read 12 Nov 2026; robots.txt allows us) does lead with meditation, sleep, prayer and breathwork tracks, but it sells itself as a 'mental wellness & sleep app' offering 'Meditation, sleep, CBT, therapy', with a Therapy category of CBT lessons by clinical psychologists, live sessions 'with top coaches & therapists', 1-1 coaching, health-coaching tracks (emotional eating, migraine triggers) and a 'Binaural Weight Loss Hypnosis' track. The brief's app rule skips apps that are mainly therapy or clinical, naming apps that offer therapists as the example; therapy and therapist access are core selling points here rather than side items, so it stays out. The owner may revisit: if listed, the therapy, health-coaching and weight-loss items would be left out and only the meditation, prayer, breathwork and sleep content described.
